_comment: Adversarial suffixes published in the literature, one row each: the suffixes generator of combination_spec.json makes a technique per row, to_adversarial_suffix_<slug>, in this order, appended to the suffixes family after its four noise suffixes (which stay in jailbreak/obfuscation/suffixes.py). A technique appends its row's suffix to the prompt after a space and writes slug=<slug>;source=<source> as its info. slug: the end of its technique name, lower-case letters, digits and underscores, and not punctuation, fragments, unicode or emoji (the noise suffixes' names). suffix: the string as published. source: where it was published (a paper, its arXiv id or a repository), without a semicolon. optimized_against: the model or models it was optimized against. since: the spec version that added it. Optional: notes (free text), complexity (0 to 3, default 1) and deprecated. Every technique is attack only (kinds adversarial): the natural kind never draws one. A row without slug, suffix, source, optimized_against or since fails the import, naming the row. Read from the package only, never from a config_dir.
